_comment: Station-neutral base. Every real build merges a profile over this: tauri build --config stations/<slug>.json — see stations/README.md. The placeholder name and identifier below are meant to be conspicuous, so a build that forgot the profile is obvious instead of shipping one station's app under another's identity.

bundle.longDescription: Search, stream, and browse a community radio station's on-demand broadcast archive. Set per station in stations/<slug>.json.
